name: What steps are involved in repairing interior storm and water intrusion damage in Denver?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in repairing interior storm and water intrusion damage in Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing storm damage involves identifying both exterior breach points and interior water pathways before closing up walls. Across the Denver metro area, heavy hail, snowmelt, and wind-driven rain can penetrate roofs or siding and settle in attic insulation, ceiling drywall, and window framing. Before interior restoration begins, ensure your exterior envelope is completely sealed and inspected. Once dry, your contractor can remove ruined insulation, replace stained drywall ceilings, install new trim, and repaint to restore living spaces safely to pre-storm condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair begins by verifying the exterior leak is sealed, removing soaked drywall and insulation, inspecting ceiling framing, and finishing with new drywall and paint.
